formats.name: scFv-His
formats.mutset: (G4S)x3 or x4 linker; C-term His6
formats.notes: VH-VL versus VL-VH orientation is a per-clone empirical call. Build both; screen both.

formats.name: scFv-Fc homodimer
formats.mutset: Hinge-CH2-CH3 fusion; LALA-PG optional
formats.notes: Half the plasmid burden of an IgG. Aggregation risk is the trade.

formats.name: VHH-Fc homodimer
formats.mutset: Hinge-CH2-CH3 fusion; humanized VHH framework
formats.notes: Single V domain acts as a complete paratope. No trans pairing, so no mispairing at all.

formats.name: Fc-fusion (N-terminal partner)
formats.mutset: Partner-hinge-CH2-CH3; hinge linker length is the key variable
formats.notes: No Fv at all. Included so the matrix covers the full production core queue.

formats.name: Tandem scFv (BiTE-like)
formats.mutset: scFv1-(G4S)-scFv2; both scFv disulfide-stabilized; C-term His6
formats.notes: No FcRn recycling, so serum half-life is hours. A delivery problem, not a construct problem.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, wild-type Fc
formats.mutset: None (parental constant regions)
formats.notes: Base case. All other rows are deltas from this one.

formats.name: IgG2 mAb
formats.mutset: Native IgG2 hinge
formats.notes: IgG2-A/A-B/B disulfide isoforms are a release attribute. Plan the HIC or RP method up front.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, effector silenced (LALA-PG)
formats.notes: Default silencing set for agonists and payload carriers. Abolishes FcgR and C1q binding, retains FcRn.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, effector silenced (LALA)
formats.notes: Residual C1q binding versus LALA-PG. Use only where a legacy comparator requires it.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, aglycosylated (N297A)
formats.mutset: N297A
formats.notes: Lower Tm in CH2. Confirm thermal stability before committing to a cell line.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, ADCC enhanced (DLE)
formats.mutset: S239D / I332E (add A330L for triple)
formats.notes: Protein engineering route. Afucosylation (FUT8-KO host) is the orthogonal, sequence-neutral route.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, half-life extended (YTE)
formats.notes: Reduced FcgR binding is a secondary effect. Pair with LALA-PG if full silencing is required.

formats.name: IgG1 mAb, half-life extended (LS)
formats.notes: Protein A elution pH shifts. Requalify the capture step; do not reuse the WT method.

formats.name: IgG4 mAb (S228P)
formats.mutset: S228P
formats.notes: S228P blocks in vivo Fab-arm exchange. Never build IgG4 without it unless cFAE is the intent.

formats.name: IgG4 mAb, silenced (S228P + FALA)
formats.notes: Retains residual FcgRI binding. LALA-PG on IgG1 is the cleaner silencing option.

formats.name: Fab fragment (recombinant)
formats.mutset: C-term His6 or Strep-II on Fd; hinge truncated at C220 (EU)
formats.notes: No Protein A handle. Choose the affinity tag at design time, not at purification.

formats.name: DART (diabody, disulfide-stabilized)
formats.mutset: Chain 1: VH-A-linker-VL-B. Chain 2: VH-B-linker-VL-A. C-term cysteines form interchain disulfide
formats.notes: Each Fv is reconstituted in trans across two chains. Both plasmids are in the registry so the build can be walked end to end.

formats.name: 2+2 IgG-scFv (scFv at HC C-term)
formats.mutset: (G4S)x3 linker at CH3 C-term; scFv disulfide-stabilized
formats.notes: Simplest MsAb to build: two plasmids, no heterodimerization. Bivalent on both targets, which may be wrong pharmacologically.

formats.name: DVD-Ig 2+2
formats.mutset: Inner/outer V domain linkers (short G/S or Ckappa-derived)
formats.notes: Outer domain binding is usually fine; inner domain affinity commonly drops. Screen both orientations.

formats.name: IgG1 ADC, stochastic lysine conjugation
formats.mutset: None; conjugation is post-translational at surface lysines
formats.chgdet: Lysine capping shifts pI downward; a product attribute, not a design element
formats.polish: HIC for DAR; SEC for aggregate
formats.notes: Roughly 80 accessible lysines gives a broad positional distribution. DAR 3-4 average, wide species spread.

formats.name: IgG1 ADC, interchain cysteine conjugation
formats.mutset: None; partial reduction of the 4 native interchain disulfides
formats.capture: Protein A, then reduce and conjugate
formats.notes: DAR distribution is even-numbered. Reduction breaks the covalent chain linkage, so the molecule is held by non-covalent contacts.

formats.name: Glycan-remodeled ADC
formats.mutset: None; conjugation handle is installed enzymatically on the N297 glycan
formats.capture: Protein A, then trim and transfer
formats.notes: Sequence-identical to the parental mAb. Everything happens downstream, which makes it attractive for lifecycle work.

formats.name: THIOMAB ADC, HC A118C
formats.mutset: HC A118C (EU)
formats.capture: Protein A, then uncap (reduce/reoxidize) and conjugate
formats.notes: The engineered cysteine expresses capped by cysteine or glutathione. The uncapping step is the process risk, not the conjugation.

formats.name: THIOMAB ADC, LC V205C
formats.mutset: LC V205C (Kabat)
formats.capture: Protein A, then uncap and conjugate
formats.notes: LC site generally gives better in vivo linker stability than HC A118C. Screen both sites for your payload.

formats.name: Transglutaminase ADC (N297Q)
formats.mutset: N297Q (removes glycan, creates acceptor Q)
formats.notes: Aglycosylated by construction, so effector function is already silenced. Confirm CH2 thermal stability.

formats.name: AOC (antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate)
formats.mutset: Site-specific cysteine (A118C or V205C) + LALA-PG
formats.chgdet: Oligo payload drives a large pI shift; AEX becomes the resolving step
formats.polish: AEX (not HIC; the oligo dominates the surface property)
formats.notes: Same construct logic as an ADC. The purification train is where AOCs diverge, because the payload is polyanionic.

formats.name: nnAA ADC (amber suppression)
formats.mutset: TAG codon at the selected site; requires orthogonal tRNA/synthetase in the host
formats.capture: Protein A, then oxime or click conjugation
formats.notes: Host engineering is the gate, not vector design. Read-through and truncation species are the characterization burden.

formats.name: DuoBody 1+1 IgG (controlled Fab-arm exchange)
formats.mutset: Parental A: F405L. Parental B: K409R
formats.kihass: Not used; CH3 exchange drives heterodimer
formats.ratio: Two separate transfections (2 plasmids each), not co-transfection
formats.mispair: None during expression; each parental is a normal monospecific mAb
formats.notes: Unique in this matrix: parentals are made independently and combined in vitro. Two production runs, one assembly step.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, in vitro assembly

formats.name: Bispecific scFv-Fc (KiH, both arms scFv)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; both scFv disulfide-stabilized
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only
formats.notes: Two plasmids for a bispecific. The cheapest MsAb to build, with scFv stability as the cost.
formats.drivers: 2 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, no light chain

formats.name: Knob-Fc half-antibody (one-armed)
formats.hcid: HC-knob (Fab arm) + HC-hole (Fc only), 1 copy each
formats.mutset: KiH set; HC-B is hinge-CH2-CH3 with no Fab
formats.notes: Monovalency without losing half-life. Standard route for agonist targets where cross-linking is the liability.

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, common light chain
formats.lcid: 1 common LC, 2 copies (shared by both arms)
formats.mutset: Knob T366W + S354C; Hole T366S/L368A/Y407V + Y349C
formats.mispair: LC mispairing eliminated by design; HC homodimer residual 1-5%
formats.polish: CEX or HIC to strip homodimer
formats.notes: Cleanest bispecific if a common LC can be found. The discovery constraint, not the build constraint, is the bottleneck.
formats.drivers: 3 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, common light chain

formats.name: Electrostatic steering Fc 1+1 (DD/KK)
formats.mutset: HC-A: K409D / K392D. HC-B: D399K / E356K
formats.chgdet: CH3 charge pairs; shifts Fc pI and gives a CEX handle
formats.mispair: Low with common LC; moderate otherwise
formats.notes: The main reason to prefer this over KiH: the same mutations that drive assembly also resolve the product.

formats.name: DEKK 1+1 IgG (Merus-style)
formats.mutset: HC-A: L351D / L368E. HC-B: L351K / T366K
formats.notes: Designed around a fixed common LC. Requires a discovery platform built on that germline.

formats.name: Azymetric ZW1 1+1 IgG
formats.notes: Reported to retain near-WT CH3 thermostability. Confirm Tm by DSC on your own material.

formats.name: SEEDbody 1+1 IgG
formats.hcid: 2 unique HC (AG and GA chains), 1 copy each
formats.mutset: Alternating IgG1/IgA CH3 segments; AG and GA strand-exchange chains
formats.notes: Not a point-mutation set. The CH3 is a chimeric module, so the vector carries the whole segment.

formats.name: 1+1 Fab x scFv, KiH, Fc-silenced (T-cell engager)
formats.lcid: 1 unique LC, 1 copy (pairs with Fab arm only)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; CD3 scFv stabilized by VH44-VL100 disulfide
formats.kihass: HC-A = Fab arm, knob. HC-B = scFv arm, hole
formats.mispair: Low; only one LC in the system
formats.notes: Silencing is mandatory, not optional. Unsilenced CD3 engagers cross-link FcgR and drive off-target activation.

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, common light chain, Fc-silenced
formats.lcid: 1 common LC, 2 copies (shared by both arms)
formats.mutset: Knob T366W + S354C; Hole T366S/L368A/Y407V + Y349C; L234A/L235A/P329G
formats.mispair: LC mispairing eliminated by design; HC homodimer residual 1-5%
formats.polish: CEX or HIC to strip homodimer
formats.notes: The workhorse bispecific for agonist and payload targets, where any Fc cross-linking is a liability.
formats.drivers: 3 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, common light chain

formats.name: Xencor-style HA-TF 1+1 IgG
formats.mutset: HC-A: S364H / F405A. HC-B: Y349T / T394F
formats.chgdet: pI-engineered Fc variants often added for CEX resolution
formats.notes: Typically paired with separate isoelectric-point engineering to make the polish step tractable.

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, engineered Fab disulfide (DuetMab-style)
formats.mutset: KiH set + CH1 F126C (Kabat) / CL S121C (Kabat) on arm B; native C220-C214 disulfide removed
formats.polish: CEX; add HIC if free-thiol species appear
formats.notes: Watch for unpaired cysteine. Add a free-thiol assay to release, not just to characterization.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, pairing engineering

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, orthogonal Fab interface
formats.mutset: KiH set + CH1 H172A/F174G (arm B) + CL L135Y/S176W (LC-B) + VH Q39K / VL Q38D
formats.kihass: HC-A = knob (native Fab), HC-B = hole (orthogonal Fab)
formats.mispair: Low to moderate; interface steering is sequence-specific
formats.notes: Keeps native domain order, so no Fv perturbation. Verify the VH/VL charge pair transfers to your framework.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, pairing engineering

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, charge-pair LC steering
formats.mutset: KiH set + CH1/CL electrostatic pairs (e.g., CH1 T192E with CL N137K/S114A)
formats.chgdet: Charge steering is at CH1/CL, not CH3
formats.polish: CEX (the same charge engineering aids resolution)
formats.notes: The charge pairs that steer assembly also give you the handle to resolve the mispaired species.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, pairing engineering

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, CrossMab CH1-CL
formats.lcid: 2 unique LC, 1 copy each (one is VL-CH1)
formats.hcid: 2 unique HC, 1 copy each (one is VH-CL)
formats.mutset: KiH set + CH1/CL domain swap on arm B
formats.kihass: HC-A = knob (native Fab), HC-B = hole (crossed Fab)
formats.mispair: Moderate. Bence-Jones and LC-LC side products need resolution
formats.polish: CEX plus KappaSelect or LambdaFabSelect subtractive step
formats.notes: Most-used crossover. Swapping CH1/CL preserves the Fv and rarely costs affinity.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, pairing engineering

formats.name: KiH 1+1 IgG, CrossMab VH-VL
formats.lcid: 2 unique LC, 1 copy each (one is VH-CL)
formats.hcid: 2 unique HC, 1 copy each (one is VL-CH1)
formats.mutset: KiH set + VH/VL domain swap on arm B
formats.notes: Affinity loss on the crossed arm is the common failure. Screen against the parental Fab.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, pairing engineering

formats.name: Bispecific ADC (KiH + THIOMAB)
formats.mutset: KiH set + A118C on one or both HC + LALA-PG
formats.polish: CEX for homodimer, then HIC for DAR
formats.notes: Two orthogonal heterogeneity axes stack: chain pairing and DAR. Define the release panel before the first build.

formats.name: 2+1 appended IgG (Fab at HC N-term)
formats.target: Bispecific 2+1 (2 sites target A, 1 site target B)
formats.mutset: KiH set + G4S linker between appended Fab and native VH
formats.mispair: High. Three Fab arms competing for two LCs
formats.polish: CEX plus SEC; expect a long polish train
formats.notes: Avidity on target A is the point. Pay for it in mispairing complexity. Use a common LC if at all possible.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, extra binding arm

formats.name: Trispecific 2+1+1 (KiH plus C-term scFv)
formats.hcid: 2 unique HC, 1 copy each (one carries C-term scFv)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG + C-term (G4S)x3-scFv on HC-B
formats.mispair: High. Two LCs, two Fab arms, plus an appended scFv
formats.polish: CEX, HIC, and SEC in series
formats.notes: Expect low titer and a long polish. Budget three to four times the material of a 1+1 to reach the same delivered mass.
formats.drivers: 4 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, two light chains, extra binding arm

formats.name: Bispecific Fab-Fc (KiH, both arms scFab)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; scFab disulfide-stabilized
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only
formats.notes: Two-plasmid Fab building blocks. Each arm is a single-chain Fab fused to Fc, so there is no free LC.
formats.drivers: 2 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, Fab building blocks

formats.name: Bispecific VHH-Fc (KiH, both arms VHH)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only
formats.notes: Two-plasmid VHH building blocks. One V domain per arm, knob-in-hole Fc.
formats.drivers: 2 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, VHH building blocks

formats.name: Bispecific Cross Fab-Fc (KiH, both arms crossed scFab)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; CrossMab CH1-CL on each scFab
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only
formats.notes: Two-plasmid Cross Fab building blocks. Domain-swapped scFab-Fc on both arms.
formats.drivers: 2 plasmids, heterodimeric Fc, Cross Fab building blocks

formats.name: Bispecific mutein-Fc (KiH, both arms mutein)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; mutein ORF on each arm
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only
formats.notes: Two-plasmid mutein building blocks. Engineered natural-protein ORFs fused to knob and hole Fc.

formats.name: Bispecific de novo protein-Fc (KiH, both arms designed protein)
formats.mutset: KiH set + LALA-PG; de novo miniprotein ORF on each arm
formats.kihass: Arm A = knob, arm B = hole
formats.mispair: None from LC (there is no LC); HC homodimer residual only

chains.name: scFv, free
chains.note: One plasmid, one binder, no Fc. Serum half-life is hours.

chains.name: Tandem scFv
chains.note: Two complete Fv on one polypeptide. Bispecific with a single plasmid.

chains.name: scFv-Fc
chains.note: Homodimeric scFv-Fc. No light chain. Use the knob and hole scFv-Fc chains for a heterodimer.

chains.name: scFv-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid bispecific scFv-Fc. Pair with the hole scFv-Fc.

chains.name: scFv-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid bispecific scFv-Fc. Also the CD3 arm on a Fab x scFv engager.

chains.name: VHH-Fc
chains.note: The simplest Fc-bearing binder to build. One insert, one plasmid.

chains.name: Fc fusion
chains.note: No Fv at all. Hinge linker length is the main design lever.

chains.name: Heavy chain, conventional
chains.note: The default. Every Fc engineering option is a vector swap at this archetype, not a new topology.

chains.name: Light chain, conventional kappa
chains.note: Two vectors with different selection markers so a stable pool can track both light chains.

chains.name: Fd, truncated heavy chain
chains.note: No Fc, so no Protein A handle. Pick the affinity tag at design time.

chains.name: DART chain 1
chains.note: VH of target A plus VL of target B. Pair with DART chain 2 to reconstitute both Fv.

chains.name: DART chain 2
chains.note: VH of target B plus VL of target A. Pair with DART chain 1 to reconstitute both Fv.

chains.name: Heavy chain with C-terminal scFv
chains.note: Carries a half-Fv and a complete Fv on one polypeptide. Two independent drop-in sites.

chains.name: Heavy chain, dual variable domain
chains.note: Inner domain affinity commonly drops. Screen both domain orders.

chains.name: Light chain, dual variable domain
chains.note: Linker design must match the heavy chain DVD cassette.

chains.name: Light chain, conjugation site
chains.note: Usually better in vivo linker stability than the heavy chain A118C site.

chains.name: Heavy chain, Fab-arm exchange parental
chains.note: Expressed as a normal monospecific mAb. Heterodimer forms in vitro, after purification.

chains.name: Heavy chain, knob
chains.note: Obligate partner: a hole chain. Never co-express with a wild-type Fc.

chains.name: Fc stump, no Fab
chains.note: Stock plasmid, no insert. Turns any Fab arm into a one-armed antibody.

chains.name: Heavy chain, hole
chains.note: Obligate partner: a knob chain. Hole homodimer is the dominant side product when ratios drift.

chains.name: Heavy chain, electrostatically steered
chains.note: Same topology as a knob or hole chain. The steering mechanism differs, and so does the polish handle.

chains.name: Light chain, common (fixed germline)
chains.note: No insert. The V region is platform, not variable. Eliminates light chain mispairing by construction.

chains.name: Heavy chain, strand-exchange CH3
chains.note: CH3 is a chimeric module, not a point-mutation set. The whole segment lives in the vector.

chains.name: Heavy chain, orthogonal Fab interface
chains.note: Native domain order preserved, so the Fv is untouched. Two of the four positions live in your insert.

chains.name: Light chain, orthogonal interface
chains.note: Steering without a domain swap. Duet variant adds a free-thiol assay to release.

chains.name: Light chain, charge-paired
chains.note: The change that steers assembly is also the change that resolves the product on CEX.

chains.name: Heavy chain, crossed CH1 to CL
chains.note: Fab is intact; only the constant domains trade places. Rarely costs affinity.

chains.name: Light chain, crossed CL to CH1
chains.note: Bence-Jones and light-chain dimer side products are the clearance burden.

chains.name: Heavy chain, crossed VH to VL
chains.note: Takes a VL insert, not a VH. The most misordered construct in the catalog.

chains.name: Light chain, crossed VL to VH
chains.note: Takes a VH insert. Pairs only with its matching crossed heavy chain.

chains.name: Heavy chain, tandem Fab
chains.note: Three Fab arms competing for two light chains. Highest mispairing burden in the catalog.

chains.name: Light chain, conventional lambda
chains.note: Changes the subtractive purification step: LambdaFabSelect, not KappaSelect.

chains.name: Fab-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid bispecific Fab-Fc. Pair with the hole scFab-Fc.

chains.name: Fab-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid bispecific Fab-Fc. Pair with the knob scFab-Fc.

chains.name: VHH-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid bispecific VHH-Fc. Pair with the hole VHH-Fc.

chains.name: VHH-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid bispecific VHH-Fc. Pair with the knob VHH-Fc.

chains.name: Cross Fab-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid Cross Fab-Fc. VL-CH1 / VH-CL swap on a single chain.

chains.name: Cross Fab-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid Cross Fab-Fc. VL-CH1 / VH-CL swap on a single chain.

chains.name: Mutein-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid mutein-Fc. Engineered natural-protein binder fused to Fc.

chains.name: Mutein-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid mutein-Fc. Engineered natural-protein binder fused to Fc.

chains.name: De novo protein-Fc, knob
chains.note: Knob arm of a two-plasmid de novo protein-Fc. Designed miniprotein binder fused to Fc.

chains.name: De novo protein-Fc, hole
chains.note: Hole arm of a two-plasmid de novo protein-Fc. Designed miniprotein binder fused to Fc.
